Town of Shelburne, Official Sample Ballot, Annual Town Meeting Election, March 3, 2026: Thomas A. Little was the sole candidate for Town Moderator (one-year term)

Town of Shelburne, 'TOWN MEETING RESULTS---UNOFFICIAL', March 3, 2026 (1,746 ballots cast; published by Town Clerk Diana Vachon): Thomas A. Little won the moderator election with 1,581 votes. The results sheet is self-labeled UNOFFICIAL; the mint rests on the official ballot (sole candidate), his incumbency in the town report, and the town's current rosters (the disclosed sole-candidate pattern, flagged on issue #163)

Town of Shelburne, Official Sample Ballot, Annual Town Meeting Election, March 3, 2026: Matt Wormser (two-year term) and Andrew Everett (three-year term) were the sole candidates for the two seats on the 2026 ballot

Town of Shelburne, 'TOWN MEETING RESULTS---UNOFFICIAL', March 3, 2026 (1,746 ballots cast; published by Town Clerk Diana Vachon): Wormser (1,465) and Everett (1,447) were returned as elected (self-labeled UNOFFICIAL sheet; corroborated by the town's current selectboard page)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 147 (Town of Shelburne): sec. 3.2: a First Constable is an elective officer (the town styles the office Town Constable)
Town of Shelburne, Official Sample Ballot, Annual Town Meeting Election, March 3, 2026: Bob Lake was the sole candidate for Town Constable (two-year term)

Town of Shelburne, 'TOWN MEETING RESULTS---UNOFFICIAL', March 3, 2026 (1,746 ballots cast; published by Town Clerk Diana Vachon): Bob Lake won with 1,476 votes (self-labeled UNOFFICIAL sheet; the mint rests on the official ballot, his incumbency in the town report, and roster concurrence -- disclosed sole-candidate pattern)
